projects.title: Soccer Agent Challenge
projects.meta: Advanced Analysis of Algorithms · Python · individual
projects.description: An AI that controls a 5-a-side soccer team in real time. It finished 14th of 269 agents and qualified for the Innovation Day Cup.
projects.what: An AI controller for a 5-a-side soccer team. It gets the pitch 20 times a second and must decide every player's move within 20 ms.
projects.how: Predicts the ball's exact path, works out who reaches it first, then defends as a compact block or plans kicks.
projects.result: 14th of 269 agents (Division 1). 894 wins, 143 draws, 79 losses (80% won). Qualified for the top-20 Innovation Day Cup.
projects.imageAlt: Cartoon robot footballers kicking a ball

projects.title: Short Order: CPU Scheduler
projects.description: A CPU scheduler that runs a simulated restaurant kitchen. It scored 100% and beats every textbook scheduling algorithm.
projects.what: A CPU scheduler that runs a simulated restaurant kitchen. Cooks are CPU cores, orders are processes, the oven is I/O.
projects.how: Decides which order each cook works on within 50 ms, balancing customers served, response time, switching cost and fairness.
projects.result: 100% for the assignment. Beats every textbook algorithm (FIFO, round robin, SJF, SRTF, MLFQ and more) and is level with the strongest reference scheduler.

projects.title: Wearable Sensor Activity Classification
projects.meta: Machine Learning · team project · Python, Jupyter
